correctness.rationale: For fixed composition, moving the first bit to the end changes the scattered 01 count by nw_i−b, so the height profile gives the exact rotation spread. Coprimality makes all n height residues distinct. Rotating to the unique minimum normalizes it to 0. Range n−1 forces the standard residue choice and hence the upper mechanical (Christoffel) word; range n repeats residue zero at its endpoints and is impossible. Range n+1 forces precisely the lift 1→n+1. At the lift the predecessor has residue b+1 and the successor a+1; a,b≥2 ensures that the entering and exiting steps swap from −b,+a to +a,−b and all other steps are unchanged. Closure gives exactly b ones. The mean over all cuts is ab/2, by counting the sum of the one positions in the normalized representative; the lift increases the mean height by 1 and gives the asserted two holes. A shorter cyclic period would repeat the rotation counts, so both necklaces have n representatives. An independent direct count (branches/e3de86da-8de0-4e43-bbba-ede5e6e13768/independent_check.py and independent_check_full.txt) covered 44 parameter pairs, 33,122 words and 457,898 rotations through n=15, reproducing the spectra and 88 extremal necklaces. The uploaded checker was read, not executed; the height argument proves the unbounded claim.
